title: 番外1项羽
content_zh:
应某人要求写的项羽，写得不好的话请原谅，还是这个世界观下的，这个是倒叙的……
乌江之前，项羽挺着双戟，看着对面的数十万大军，华盖之下，一身帝服华佩的那人遥遥站在那里，那就是他曾经的兄弟——刘邦。
“项羽，你败了！”韩信跃马而出，未有丝毫的畏惧，千古第一武将就在他的面前，但是他面无惧色。
望着那延绵不绝的土灰色云气，还有那如同炎光一般的光罩，项羽看着面前那自己曾经的手下——韩信。
曾经没有云气，更没有军团天赋，也没有那不败信念铸就的军魂，他靠着自己的实力以一敌万，多少万大军在他面前都不过是蝼蚁而已！
“叔父，教我万人敌之术！”恍惚之间项羽想起了小时候的自己，那个时候他的叔父项梁教他兵法，教他武艺，项家的子弟，都视他为项家崛起的希望。
再看看现在的情况，自己的指天发誓，带着走向胜利，走向辉煌的八千子弟早已战死沙场，而视自己为项家崛起希望的族人，已经依附在刘邦的麾下，改姓为刘，自己最深爱的女人，也在垓下，曼舞一阕挥剑自杀。
追随他的手下一一战死，一直鼓励他的族人背离，深爱的女子死在怀中，为什么都不信我！我可是不败的霸王，为什么！
纵使有肩挑泰山之力，这一刻项羽连一点都发挥不出来，犹记曾经，一人破万军，而现在却在面对对方大军的一刻感到无比的疲累。
“投降吧，项羽。”韩信看着项羽，纵使面前这位曾经能推山摧峰，这一刻他也没有丝毫的畏惧。
为了击败面前这个近乎怪物一般的存在，他创造了勾连大军的云气阵法，创造了勾连意志的军团天赋，而且为了击败面前这位足以一人征服天下的男子，他一路路完成无数次不可思议的大战，以自己为核心树立起百十万大军对于他必胜的信念。
“降？”项羽漠然的看着面前的韩信。
到了现在，项羽不得不承认，这天下能阻止他的只有面前的韩信，至于张良的奇谋，萧何的筹谋，陈平曹参的诡计对于他来说都是笑话，夏侯婴，周勃，樊哙更是蝼蚁，只要他愿意，随时都能轰杀成渣！
“投降吧，你不是我的对手，你的手下已经完了。”韩信看着项羽说道，“曾经跟随你的所有人都背离了你，你已经不可能和我们再争下去了。”
“哈哈哈哈！”项羽仰天狂笑，“我项羽一生纵横天下未逢一败，今日天亡我，那我就看看这天有多厚！刘三，不要以为你胜了，今天我就让你明白，我为什么一直没想过杀你们！”
项羽大吼一声，直接丢掉手中的大戟朝着六十万大军冲了上去，在距离大军还有数十米的时候，项羽一拳挥出，整个空气直接爆出了火焰，然后正面凹下去了一个漏洞，一击之下百十米范围的士卒直接轰杀成渣！
“给我死！”韩信大吼一声，将六十万大军的云气聚合起来，一道巨大的斧头直接朝着项羽的方向轰去。
“韩信，我今日就让你知道，你所创造出来的云气军阵不过是笑话！”项羽朝着韩信冷笑。
看着那足以劈山断海的巨斧，项羽深吸一口气，然后一声大喝，右拳直接轰向那柄巨斧，一声巨大的轰鸣，随后迸发出惊人的冲击，直接将正面数千士卒扫飞了出去，而烟尘尽去之后，燃烧了内气的项羽身上燃烧着黑色的火焰，整个人就像是鬼神一般虚立在天空之中，发髻凌乱，但是发丝却无风自动！
“怎么可能！”后方的刘邦看着这一幕当即慌乱无比，如此强悍的攻击之下项羽怎么可能还活着。

“刘三，让我来告诉你事实，老子只要活着，这天下根本不会有人能击败我，让你见识一下我真正的力量！”项羽的咆哮声对于下方的士卒来说几乎是振聋发聩，而且这也是他们第一次见到项羽飞行。
“给我起！”项羽伸手朝着数千米之外的一座小山抓去，只见手腕直接延伸出一道数千米的巨掌，然后一阵地动山摇之后项羽将那数百米高的大山拔了出来。
“刘三，我看到你了，你说这座山丢下去，你的六十万大军还有多少，或者说，你们谁能挡住？”项羽虚立天空，用他那内气双手抓着山峰询问道，他激发了神石的核心，战友战死，族人背弃，心爱的女子已死，他已经生无可恋了。
“这怎么可能？”韩信难以置信的看着天空的项羽，下方的大军在看到这一幕几乎已经崩溃了，若非有韩信的军团天赋还有军魂约束，现在大概已经崩溃了，这种力量在任何一个时代都足以称为仙神！
“不管可能不可能，你们死定了！刘三受死！”项羽直接将那座山峰朝着刘邦的方向丢了过去，就这短短一会，举起一座山峰消耗的内气，让项羽都无法承受。
“绝对能挡住，绝对能挡住。”这一刻韩信双眼几乎瞪圆，玩命的调动所有人的信念，不管这一刻在这里不在这里的士卒，他所赋予的不败信念这一刻全数响应了韩信的呼应，足够多的信念，足以创造奇迹的信念。
“咚！”合数百万人的军魂信念，韩信奋力斩出一击，将那座山峰轰碎，并且挡住所有余波冲击的瞬间，韩信也几乎倒地不起。
“去死吧！”项羽几乎完全没有停顿直接朝着刘邦的方向一拳轰去，至于旁边的张良等人，他根本视而不见，他的实力足以无视精神冲击，至于夏侯婴等人，连炼气成罡的实力都没有，他如何会畏惧！
“咚！”一层金红色的光泽化成一个球状，为刘邦挡住了致命一击！
“赤霄剑？”项羽一愣，随后瞬间明悟了一切，“原来这就是所谓的天子剑的显化！”
“刘三我对你如何？”项羽看着在那层金红光罩中惊慌的刘邦，冷笑着问道是，随后不等刘邦回答，身后直接抓着那层光罩狂拽数千米，直接出现在乌江边。
看着已经昏迷的刘邦，项羽双手发力，原本圆球形的光球防御，直接被项羽按成一团，之后一阵如同玻璃碎裂的声音，原本艳红的赤霄剑一阵黯淡。
“天子剑？呵呵呵，拥有者可为天子，我倒要看看区区你又没有这个资格。”项羽抓着赤霄剑一阵扭曲，他要掰了赤霄剑，与其恨刘三这个蝼蚁，还不掰了这个扭曲了他命运的天子剑！
这一刻项羽身上迸发出无数的内气，庞大的内气直接将一旁的刘邦吹飞了出去，而天子剑带的所谓的万民信念，死死的抵抗着项羽的力量，不过终归并非是轩辕夏禹剑，硬是被狂暴的项羽掰断，这个世界不需要这种操控人心的力量！
“咔吧~”在赤霄剑被折断的瞬间，整个天下人都听到了这么一声，而项羽也因为赤霄剑突然折断，在他那巨大的力量之下，一个不小心斩向自己的脖颈。
“噗！”鲜血疯狂的溢出，染满了项羽面前，握着已经成为两半的赤霄剑，项羽一动不动的站在那里，任凭生命流逝，也许这样死在自己手上也是一种结束。
content_en:
Xiang Yu was written at the request of someone. Please forgive me if the writing is not good. It is still based on this world view. This is a flashback...
In front of Wujiang River, Xiang Yu held up his two halberds and looked at the hundreds of thousands of troops on the opposite side. Under the canopy, a man in imperial uniform stood there far away. That was his former brother-Liu Bang.
"Xiang Yu, you are defeated!" Han Xin jumped out of the horse without the slightest fear. The number one general in history was right in front of him, but he showed no fear on his face.
Looking at the endless earth-gray clouds and the flame-like light shield, Xiang Yu looked at his former subordinate in front of him - Han Xin.
There was no cloud energy, no legion talent, and no military soul forged by undefeated belief. He relied on his own strength to defeat ten thousand, and tens of thousands of troops were nothing more than ants in front of him!
"Uncle, teach me the art of defeating thousands of people!" Xiang Yu suddenly remembered his childhood. At that time, his uncle Xiang Liang taught him the art of war and martial arts. The children of the Xiang family all regarded him as the hope for the rise of the Xiang family.
Looking at the current situation, the eight thousand descendants whom I swore to lead to victory and glory have long since died on the battlefield, and the tribesmen who regard themselves as the hope for the rise of the Xiang family have attached themselves to Liu Bang and changed their surname to Liu. The woman he loved most also committed suicide with a sword in Gaixia.
The men who followed him died in battle, the people who had been encouraging him to defect, the woman he loved died in his arms, why don't you believe me! I am an undefeated overlord, why!
Even though he had the strength to shoulder the weight of Mount Tai, Xiang Yu couldn't even exert himself at this moment. He still remembered that once, one man defeated ten thousand armies, but now he felt extremely tired when facing the opponent's army.
"Surrender, Xiang Yu." Han Xin looked at Xiang Yu. Even though the man in front of him could push mountains and destroy peaks, he didn't have the slightest fear at this moment.
In order to defeat the almost monster-like existence in front of him, he created the cloud formation to connect the army, and created the legion talent to connect the will. In order to defeat the man in front of him who could conquer the world by himself, he completed countless incredible battles along the way, using himself as the core to establish the belief of a million-strong army that he would win.
"Surrender?" Xiang Yu looked at Han Xin in front of him indifferently.
Now, Xiang Yu had to admit that the only person in the world who could stop him was Han Xin. As for Zhang Liang's schemes, Xiao He's plans, Chen Ping and Cao Shen's tricks, they were all jokes to him. Xia Houying, Zhou Bo, and Fan Kuai were even more like ants. He could kill them to pieces at any time as long as he wanted!
"Surrender, you are no match for me. Your men are finished." Han Xin looked at Xiang Yu and said, "Everyone who once followed you has turned their backs on you. It is impossible for you to continue fighting with us."
"Hahahaha!" Xiang Yu looked up to the sky and laughed wildly, "I, Xiang Yu, have never been defeated in my whole life. If the sky kills me today, then I will see how thick the sky is! Liu San, don't think you have won. Today I will let you understand why I have never thought of killing you!"
Xiang Yu roared, threw away the halberd in his hand and charged towards the 600,000-strong army. When he was still tens of meters away from the army, Xiang Yu punched out, and the whole air exploded with flames, and then a hole was dented in the front. With one blow, the soldiers within a range of 100 meters were directly smashed to pieces!
"Die!" Han Xin roared, gathering the clouds of the 600,000-strong army, and blasted a huge ax directly in the direction of Xiang Yu.
"Han Xin, I will let you know today that the cloud formation you created is just a joke!" Xiang Yu sneered at Han Xin.
Looking at the huge ax that could split mountains and seas, Xiang Yu took a deep breath, then shouted loudly, and hit the huge ax directly with his right fist. There was a huge roar, and then an astonishing impact burst out, directly sweeping away thousands of soldiers in front of him, and after the smoke and dust disappeared, they burnedXiang Yu's body was burning with black flames. He was standing in the sky like a ghost. His bun was messy, but there was no wind in his hair!
"How is that possible!" Liu Bang from behind was immediately panicked when he saw this scene. How could Xiang Yu still be alive under such a powerful attack?
"Liu San, let me tell you the truth. As long as I live, no one in this world can defeat me. Let you see my true power!" Xiang Yu's roar was almost deafening to the soldiers below, and this was also the first time they saw Xiang Yu flying.
"Get up!" Xiang Yu reached out and grabbed a hill several thousand meters away. He saw a giant palm extending thousands of meters directly from his wrist, and then the mountain shook. After that, Xiang Yu pulled out the mountain several hundred meters high.
"Liu San, I saw you. If you throw this mountain away, how many more of your 600,000 troops will you have? Or, in other words, who of you can stop it?" Xiang Yu stood in the sky and asked, grabbing the mountain with both hands of his inner energy. He inspired the core of the divine stone. His comrades died in battle, his tribe abandoned him, and his beloved woman was dead. He had no hope of life.
"How is this possible?" Han Xin looked at Xiang Yu in the sky in disbelief. The army below almost collapsed when they saw this scene. If it weren't for Han Xin's legion talent and military soul restraint, they would probably have collapsed by now. This kind of power is enough to be called an immortal god in any era!
"Regardless of the possibility, you are dead! Liu San suffers death!" Xiang Yu directly threw the mountain in the direction of Liu Bang. In just a short moment, the energy consumed by lifting a mountain was too much for Xiang Yu to bear.
"It can definitely be blocked, it can definitely be blocked." At this moment, Han Xin's eyes almost widened, and he desperately mobilized everyone's faith. Regardless of whether the soldiers were here or not at this moment, the undefeated faith he gave them all responded to Han Xin's echo at this moment. Enough faith, enough faith to create miracles.
"Boom!" In line with the military spirit belief of millions of people, Han Xin struck out with all his strength, smashing the mountain into pieces and blocking all the aftermath. The moment Han Xin almost fell to the ground.
"Go to hell!" Xiang Yu punched Liu Bang in the direction of Liu Bang without any pause at all. As for Zhang Liang and others beside him, he turned a blind eye at all. His strength was enough to ignore the mental impact. As for Xia Houying and others, they didn't even have the strength to refine Qi into a gang, so how could he be afraid!
"Boom!" A layer of golden-red luster turned into a ball, blocking Liu Bang's fatal blow!
"Red Sky Sword?" Xiang Yu was stunned for a moment, and then he understood everything instantly, "So this is the manifestation of the so-called Emperor's Sword!"
"Liu San, what do I do to you?" Xiang Yu looked at Liu Bang who was panicking in that layer of golden-red light and asked with a sneer. Then without waiting for Liu Bang to answer, he grabbed the layer of light behind him and dragged it for several kilometers, directly appearing on the bank of Wujiang River.
Looking at the unconscious Liu Bang, Xiang Yu exerted force with both hands. The originally spherical light ball defense was directly pressed into a ball by Xiang Yu. Then there was a sound like glass breaking, and the originally bright red Chixiao Sword dimmed.
"The Emperor's Sword? Hahaha, the owner is the Emperor, but I want to see that you don't have the qualifications." Xiang Yu grabbed the Scarlet Sky Sword and twisted it for a while. He wanted to break the Scarlet Sky Sword. Instead of hating the ant Liu San, he would break the Emperor's Sword that had distorted his destiny!
At this moment, countless inner energy burst out from Xiang Yu's body, and the huge inner energy directly blew Liu Bang away. The so-called faith of the people carried by the Emperor's Sword resisted Xiang Yu's power, but after all, it was not the Xuanyuan Xia Yu sword that was broken by the violent Xiang Yu. This world does not need this kind of power to control people's hearts!
"Crack~" At the moment when the Scarlet Sky Sword was broken, everyone in the world heard such a sound, and Xiang Yu also felt that because of the sudden break of the Scarlet Sky Sword, under his huge powerThen, one accidentally slashed at his neck.
"Poof!" Blood overflowed crazily, staining it in front of Xiang Yu. Holding the Chixiao Sword that had been split into two halves, Xiang Yu stood there motionless, letting his life go by. Maybe dying in his own hands would also be the end.
